_purpose: Canonical seeded demo comparison used by the GTM tour (leaves/gtm/tour.html). Other leaves that ship a demo/example (engineering sample log, app Load-example button, design mocks) should use these exact values so every artifact tells one consistent story. All derived numbers are VERIFIED against the shipped engine: pairwisepm.compare() with configs/one_to_n.yaml defaults (n_boot=2000, seed=7) reproduces p, logit, interval, contributions, parity paths, and both verdicts exactly (exchange round, 2026-08-30; re-verified against the post-integration build — README sdk_version 6.26.0 — negotiation round 1, 2026-08-30: p=0.5854, interval (0.5225, 0.6445), variant p=0.5461 straddling, all contributions and parity targets exact).
_recompute_on: D1 resolution. If Decisions D1 changes any prior weight, every derived number here and in tour.html must be recomputed — flag GTM.

entry_conventions.risk_surface: Entered directly on the REVERSED 0-4 scale (4 = lowest exposure), matching configs/one_to_n.yaml. The raw_inputs below carry both the underlying exposure (for narrative) and the reversed value actually entered (risk_scored_reversed = what goes in the form).
entry_conventions.effort: Person-weeks; identical inputs produce a zero delta and zero contribution (deliberate teaching point).
